identity:
Inject subject with 10 ml of 51x-"Landru" compound
Subject was first asked to run distances of 100m, 400m, and 1 km; times were compared to previously-set reference times taken the previous day.  While the subject measureably improved their performance, finishing an average of 7% faster, the difference was still within normative athletic performance for subject's age and sex.
Following period of rest, subject was asked to perform a target-shooting demonstration using a standard-issue sidearm at 50m and completed it less than ten seconds.  Observers at the time stated the that the subject barely appeared to aim at all; playback of recorded video shows subject making extremely-rapid small adjustments to aim at a greatly-increased speed.
Following demonstration, subject was leaving the room when they accidentally struck the table with their knee.  They collapsed on the ground, grabbing their knee, but a subsequent examination showed no serious or lasting injury.  Subject would only say that it, "hurt like absolute hell" and refused further treatment.
Over the course of the observation period, subject ate approximately 25% more food than normal without an appreciable gain in body mass (measured at the beginning and end of the week-long period).  Recipients of 51x-"Landru" should be sure to follow proper dietary protocols.

entries.developer_comments:
~ NPC dialogue line
~ You find all manner of things.  But, you walk in and there are things
where you might not expect them to be.  Tools ready to use.  Bionics ready
to take, like bait on a snare, too tempting.  Listen carefully: you won't
find gifts there.  You are a thief in the night, stealing what you want.
You're a fish, and the treasures are hooks.
identity: Ye find all manner of things - treasures in troves.  But, ye trapse in, an' things where they oughtn't.  Tools laid ready.  Bright an' steelies waitin' like a snare, too fair.  Mark ol' Rubik well:  what ye find there ain't gifts.  Yer a tea leaf in the night, nickin' what you want and can.  Yer a fish, and the treasure's a hook.
